facts.value: French Economic Courses
There are a total of 4 different courses French Economic (A-B-C-D) offered in the elective module courses Business French. One course is offered each semester on a rotating basis.
C1.1 according to the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR)
The fee-based course Business French 3 'Advanced' is well-suited for preparing for the elective module courses.
Preliminary admission for the qualification section of the bachelor's exam according to PO §9 paragraph 5.
There is a two-step registration process with different deadlines. You must participate in both steps and pass the Online Qualifying Test.
Registration deadline: September 21, 2026 – October 5, 2026 via QIS
Exam registration and deregistration deadline: October 8, 2026 – October 21, 2026 via QIS.

Successful completion of a qualifying test at CEFR level B2.2, which takes place at the beginning of each semester if no bachelor elective module course in Business French has been successfully completed.

Students who hold a Baccalauréat, Abibac, or DALF / DELF C1 must upload this language certificate in PDF format during the Online Qualifying Test on September 28, 2026, between the specified time slots.
FBCA
The Business Environment (Winter Semester 2026/27)
The business environment, French economic system, current challenges (e.g., energy efficiency, digital companies, changes in the world of work), French companies in globalization.
Marie Thevenin
Wednesdays from 14:00 – 16:00, Starting: October 14, 2026 (Qualifying Test on September 28, 2026)
Room: See LSF
FBCB
Economic Policy in France (Summer Semester 2027)
Goals and actors of economic policy in France, instruments of economic policy, labor market policy, social policy, environmental policy.
FBCC
Marketing – The Company and Its Markets (Winter Semester 2027/28)
Marketing strategy and marketing mix, brands and brand management – the new trends, innovative marketing, digital marketing, communication, and social media marketing.
FBCD
Corporate Management and Corporate Financing (Summer Semester 2028)
Corporate strategies, management and corporate structure, entrepreneurship and corporate management, financing.

Successful completion of a portfolio without a written exam in the central examination phase. The portfolio components are completed in conjunction with the event. The type and scope of individual portfolio components will be communicated at the beginning of the event.
All participants receive 6 credit points for successfully completing an elective module course in French Economics.
An internal C1.1 certificate will be issued for the successfully completed course.
